title: Marilyn R NDE 6158
content: One day my father took my mother, sister and myself to my aunt’s for a day visit while he went to work. My mother and her sister were making a quilt. Because it was raining outside my three cousins, my sister and I were told to go to the basement to play in the playroom. We decided to play ‘Horse & Rider’, a game where one person has a skipping rope tied around their neck, gets on their hands and knees, while another sits on their back, and rides them around. I was picked to be the horse, and my older cousin tied the skipping rope in knots around my neck. I told her it was too tight and to loosen it. She instead tied it tighter, which made it hard for me to breath. I asked her again to loosen it, and again she made it tighter and said she could not do it. I was getting very little air at this time. In a panic I said to my younger sister ‘Get it off’, which she tried but could not get the knots out. She said ‘Go get mom’. I started for the stairs but felt myself fall down and slipped into total darkness. I was able to breath but it felt like I was blind. I was scared to death and afraid to move. I could hear scary sounds in the dark, which I could not see, and started to cry. Suddenly I saw a white light in the distance. I thought I should try to get there, but was too scared to move in the dark. It sounded like someone was walking towards me but I could not see them. I felt someone pick me up in their arms and I was surrounded by light. I looked in the smiling face of a man, who said his name was Jesus. He told me not to be frightened; he was here to take me back. He had shoulder length brown hair and dark brown eyes. He was wearing leather sandals on his feet with straps that went between his toes and tied around his ankles. He had on a long white gown with long gig sleeves, with a long light blue tunic over it. There was a gold color rope tied around his waist. His voice was very soft and kind, almost musical, and I felt a feeling of pure love, complete safety and trust. As we were walking up the stairs, I noticed that the left side of the wall was still the basement wall, but the right side of the wall had disappeared. In its place was a beautiful garden full of long grass and wild flowers. I could hear birds singing and there were butterflies flying. I could see little children playing and chasing little lambs, and I could hear their laughter. It looked so much fun. I asked if I could go play with the kids and was told ‘No, there is no time today for that I have had you too long as it is’. He told me to be a good girl and made me promise to tell the world about what I saw, and if I did that then when my time comes, I will be able to walk in the garden with him. He had kissed my forehead with his hand on the basement door and said ‘You go back now child, it’s not your time’, and the door opened and he stood me on the floor. I was not able to breath and was gulping in air. My mother and aunt came running and cut the rope off my neck. My neck was all red and sore and my voice was all hoarse. My mother asked ‘How did you get up the stairs like that?’ I said ‘I didn't, the man carried me up’. My mom and aunt asked together ‘What man?’. My aunt yelled down stairs ‘Girls, is there a man down there?’ They all said that there was no man. I said ‘There was a man and he did carry me’. They did not believe me. I went back down in the basement and asked my cousins and sister about the man, who they did not see. My sister said she saw me fall and started to come to help me but I had disappeared when she got to the stairs. No-one saw me being carried. I had a big cut on my chin where I hit the bottom step when I went into complete blackness. Everyone saw me fall and disappear. No-one saw me going up the stairs.

arrival.religious_figure_detail: A smiling man who said his name was Jesus; shoulder-length brown hair, dark brown eyes; leather sandals; long white gown; light blue tunic; gold-colored rope tied around his waist; soft, kind, almost musical voice.

environment.environment_other_detail: A beautiful garden replacing the right side of the stairway wall: long grass and wild flowers, birds singing, butterflies flying; little children playing and chasing lambs, with laughter.

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: Jesus kissed her forehead at the basement door, said 'You go back now child, it’s not your time', the door opened, and he stood her on the floor.
boundary_and_return.mission_detail: Told to "be a good girl" and promise to "tell the world about what I saw"; if she did, "when my time comes, I will be able to walk in the garden with him."

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Strangulation/asphyxiation from a skipping rope tied tightly around her neck while playing in a basement.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Darkness/void with scary sounds; carried by Jesus; stairway where one wall became a garden; physical return with inability to breathe until rope cut off.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Rather than a tunnel, she slipped into total darkness/void, then saw a distant white light; she was picked up and carried by Jesus through a stairway where a garden appeared, then returned at the basement door.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: During ascent up the basement stairs, the left wall remained the basement wall while the right wall disappeared and was replaced by a garden scene with children and lambs.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "I slipped into total darkness." "Suddenly I saw a white light in the distance." "He said his name was Jesus." "No, there is no time today for that I have had you too long as it is" "You go back now child, it’s not your time"
